input_output: Issue: rule_id/version, severity, RecordKey entity, RecordVersion input, field/message/actual/expected. CheckReport: id/principal/signature/input/analysis/target/catalog_version/issues/outcome.
RuleCatalog::check and CheckService::run/get return Result<CheckReport>; issue_state derives current/stale from the report and current view.
implemented_subset.errors_and_effects: run admits Caller/WriteContext/key and persists auxiliary rows through application CAS. Its Result may succeed with CheckReport.outcome needs_input or failed. get is read-only. Repair increments model revision separately; recheck and issue_state must invalidate the old report.
implemented_subset.implemented_boundary: LocateIssue/PlanRepair are planned service names absent from the mapped header. Desktop analysis tools locate the Issue entity; repair is an explicit prepare_set_references operation, not direct CheckService model mutation. Installed controlled rules do not certify all engineering scenarios.
